name: United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC)
description: This committee focuses on global challenges like drug trafficking, crime prevention, and corruption. Delegates debate practical legal and policy solutions to real-world security issues using standard ROP.
topics: Mitigating the Use of Cryptocurrency in Money Laundering
Balancing Civilian Privacy with Cross-Border Surveillance

name: United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS)
description: UNCLOS explores international maritime law, tackling topics like territorial waters, resource rights, and environmental protection.

name: League of Nations (LoN)
description: This historical committee recreates the world's first major international diplomatic body, debating early 20th century cirses. LoN is best suited for advanced delegates.
topics: Addressing International Frameworks for War Accountability

name: United Nations Economic Commission for Africa (UNECA)
description: This ECOSOC committee focuses on economic development issues in Africa, addressing economic and regional issues. UNECA is perfect for beginner delegates interested in geopolitics and development.
topics: Addressing Economic Corruption in African Governance
Ensuring Ethical and Sustainable Resource Management in Africa

name: United Nations Permanent Forum on Indigenous Issues (UNPFII)
description: This committee centers around indigenous issues globally, discussing cultural preservation and rights. UNPFII suits delegates passionate about indigenous advocacy and are open to a standard ROP with a few specialized motions.
topics: Ensuring Political Representation for Indigenous Communities
Addressing Government Responsibility in Preserving Indigenous Languages

name: The Silk Road (TSR)
description: Explore the trade routes from East to West that connected the ancient world in this historical committee. TSR is ideal for delegates who want to explore the rich history of trade and cultural exchange, and who are open to a specialized ROP.
topics: The Origin of the Black Plague

name: Newfoundland Commission of Government (NCOG)
description: This introductory specialized committee is great for delegates hoping to explore less common ROP structures. NCOG uses a modified British Parliamentary ROP and is perfect for delegates interested in Canadian history and governance.

name: Cicada 3301 (C-3301)
description: Hailing from the depths of the internet, this puzzling committee is where cryptography, espionage and coded problem-solving shape debate.

name: AD-HOC
description: This committee's topic will be revealed on conference day and it best suited for advanced delegates. Prepare for an exciting and secretive experience!

name: Historical Cabinet (H-CAB)
description: This historical committee follows a cabinet ROP and is best suited for delegates with significant specialized or crisis committee experience.

name: Environmental Crisis Committee (ECC)
description: Travel to the future and explore this beginner-friendly crisis committee. ECC centers on environmental emergencies rooted in current events, challenging delegates to reflect on the present to better the future.

name: Financial Crisis Committee (FCC)
description: This intermediate committee challenges delegates to navigate significant and widespread financial turmoil in a fast-paced environment.

name: League of Immortals (LoI)
description: In this crisis committee blending mythology, cross-cultural research and emergency decision-making, delegates must integrate diverse cultural perspectives into an evolving crisis scenario.
